newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO opens liaison office in Brussels.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO opens liaison office in Brussels.

text.p: Dutch financial giant ABN AMRO said on Monday it would open a liaison office in Brussels to monitor new European Union legislation, the allocation of development subsidies and EU enlargement.
It would also track developments in international payments.
The office's managing director, Jaap Kamp, is already a board member of SWIFT, a Brussels-based alliance of over 3,000 banks cooperating in the field of international payments.
ABN AMRO bank has more than 1,670 branches in 68 countries, including all the countries of the European Union.
It is Europe's fifth biggest bank and ranks 14th worldwide.
